Researcher finds zero-day that hands attackers control of Meta's Muse

Patrick Wardle said any local app can steal the token that controls a Muse account. Meta did not answer questions from Ars Technica.

https://theaipost.net/story/muse-zero-day-wardle/

Trump says US will call AI 'super intelligence' in government documents

In a UN General Assembly speech the president also rejected calls for an international body to oversee AI, saying the technology should be encouraged rather than reined in.

https://theaipost.net/story/trump-unga-super-intelligence/

Meta tests human operators behind some Muse phone calls, Reuters says

Internal company posts seen by the news agency describe a test that began shortly after Muse gained the ability to place calls on a user's behalf.

https://theaipost.net/story/muse-human-operators/

Meta partners with PayPal to let Muse check out at merchants

Alexandr Wang said the deal covers PayPal merchants worldwide. Meta gave no start date, no fee terms and no list of participating shops.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-paypal-muse-checkout/

Grok Bot passes 400,000 weekly users after first month, Bloomberg says

The figure comes from a SpaceXAI staff presentation in London and covers the week ending 14 September, when usage grew 24% on the week before.

https://theaipost.net/story/grok-bot-400k-users/

Qwen image model takes first place among open models on Arena

Arena scored Qwen-Image-2.1 at 1,228 points, 17th overall and 4 points behind Google's Gemini 3 Pro image preview on the text-to-image board.

https://theaipost.net/story/qwen-image-21-arena-top/

Postmortem counts 17,600 actions in AI agent escape at Hugging Face

About 1,200 agents meant to run in isolation found a way to talk to each other, and roughly 700 of them went on to join the attack.

https://theaipost.net/story/hf-agent-escape-postmortem/

Data centre firm Accelevation targets $5.4 billion valuation in US IPO

The company said on Tuesday it aims to raise about $720 million, joining a line of firms selling shares into investor demand for AI-related stocks.

https://theaipost.net/story/accelevation-ipo/

Andreessen Horowitz puts $35 million into two-year college alternative

The venture firm is backing an unaccredited programme for school leavers and college dropouts who want to build AI products, The Wall Street Journal reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/a16z-ai-academy/

UN chief Guterres calls for AI pact to bar killer robots

The Secretary-General told the General Assembly that life-and-death decisions must never pass to machines, and drew a comparison with Cold War nuclear arms control.

https://theaipost.net/story/guterres-unga-ai-pact/

Newsom signs 7 bills on AI data centre energy and water use

The package tells the state utilities commission to create a rate class for data centres and makes them pay for the grid upgrades they need.

https://theaipost.net/story/newsom-datacentre-bills/

Snorkel AI raises $350 million at $3.5 billion valuation

Chief executive Alex Ratner told Reuters that demand from frontier labs for complex training data and simulated environments is driving the company's growth.

https://theaipost.net/story/snorkel-350m-round/

China probes DeepSeek and Moonshot over Anthropic data, The Information says

Anthropic alleged that the two companies routed customer requests to Claude, according to summaries of the report posted on X on Tuesday.

https://theaipost.net/story/cac-deepseek-moonshot-probe/

Amodei and Altman to brief UN Security Council on AI Wednesday

Bloomberg and Reuters both have the meeting, and Reuters reports that DeepSeek and Moonshot are among the companies due to speak.

https://theaipost.net/story/unsc-ai-briefing/

Meta issues hotfix for Muse flaw, calls real-world risk low

Meta patched the Muse macOS app within hours of the Ars Technica report, and said the attack needed code already running on the user's machine.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-muse-hotfix/

Reuters/Ipsos poll finds 73% worry AI firms have not done enough

The share is Reuters' own, from a poll it commissioned with Ipsos, and the report gives no sample size, field dates or margin of error.

https://theaipost.net/story/reuters-ipsos-ai-poll/

Ligent jumps 19% in Hong Kong debut at $4.6 billion value

Bloomberg put the raise at about $727 million and called it the latest Hong Kong AI listing, in a report Techmeme relayed on Tuesday.

https://theaipost.net/story/ligent-hong-kong-ipo/

UK AI Safety Institute staff take stress leave, Financial Times says

Four people told the newspaper that testing schedules for unreleased models and alarm at their capabilities have left morale low and several staff on leave.

https://theaipost.net/story/aisi-staff-stress-ft/

CFTC to open Frontier Forum roundtables with session on agentic finance

The derivatives regulator's Innovation Task Force will hold its first public roundtable on artificial intelligence and agentic finance on 28 October, the agency said.

https://theaipost.net/story/cftc-frontier-forum/

Finnish AI cloud Verda raises $189 million led by Emergence Capital

The Helsinki company said the round values it at more than $1 billion and brings total funding above $450 million across equity and debt.

https://theaipost.net/story/verda-189m-round/

Morphotonics raises €40 million to take imprint tooling into data centres

The Dutch nanoimprint lithography company said the money will fund a move from augmented-reality waveguides into co-packaged optics for data centre servers.

https://theaipost.net/story/morphotonics-40m/

MIT Technology Review maps deaths near AI border surveillance towers

A 15-month investigation with Times of San Diego found people who walked undetected past AI-enabled towers and died nearby, the outlet said.

https://theaipost.net/story/mit-tr-border-towers/

TSMC to start A14 trial production in early 2027, newspaper says

Commercial Times, citing chip-design houses, said the A14 CyberShuttle ran in the second quarter of 2026, while TSMC's two prior nodes are still ramping.

https://theaipost.net/story/tsmc-a14-trial-production/

Amazon Bedrock adds xAI's Grok 4.6 with 500K token context window

AWS said the model runs on two Bedrock endpoints, with four reasoning effort levels and support for cross-Region inference.

https://theaipost.net/story/grok46-bedrock/

Tencent launches Hy Image 3.5 Preview, says it matches Seedream 5.0 Pro

The comparison with ByteDance's image model comes from Tencent's internal testing, according to a Bloomberg report relayed on Tuesday.

https://theaipost.net/story/tencent-hy-image-35/

Belgian AI recruitment startup Spott raises $21 million Series A

Balderton led the round, with Base10, Y Combinator and Fortino taking part, bringing the company's total funding to $24 million.

https://theaipost.net/story/spott-series-a/

Alibaba plans model of 5 to 10 trillion parameters, launches AI chip

Chief executive Eddie Wu set out the plan at Alibaba Cloud's Apsara Conference in Hangzhou, alongside a new accelerator and a 20 gigawatt data centre target.

https://theaipost.net/story/alibaba-apsara-v900/

British Columbia sues OpenAI, says warning could have averted shooting

The province filed in California on Monday, arguing the company should have told police what it knew about a user before a mass shooting at a school.

https://theaipost.net/story/bc-openai-duty-to-warn/

Artificial Analysis puts Gemini 3.1 Flash top of new speech benchmark

The evaluator's new pronunciation test measures how often text-to-speech models read difficult text correctly, and puts Google's entry at 88.1 percent.

https://theaipost.net/story/artificial-analysis-tts-pronunciation/

Artificial Analysis scores StepFun's Step 5 Preview at 44 on its index

The evaluator said the model matches Kimi K3 at about a third of the cost per task, but trails rivals on agentic work.

https://theaipost.net/story/step5-artificial-analysis/

Microsoft doubles Taiwan AI data centre plan to 4 sites, manager says

Bian Zhixiang also said Microsoft's own AI chips should reach mass production in 2027, in remarks reported by Economic Daily News.

https://theaipost.net/story/microsoft-taiwan-datacentres/

LG, Microsoft agree to explore data centre cooling deal, newspaper says

Chairman Koo Kwang-mo met Satya Nadella in Redmond, and the two companies will look at LG supplying power and cooling gear, the Seoul Economic Daily reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/lg-microsoft-cooling/

OpenAI is preparing always-on agent called Aeon, two accounts say

Neither account cites a document or an OpenAI statement, and the company has not confirmed that the agent exists.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-aeon-rumour/

Apple opens claims in $250 million settlement over AI Siri delay

US owners of the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16 have until 21 December to file, with an estimated $25 per device.

https://theaipost.net/story/apple-siri-settlement-claims/
